title: Limits to Predicting Online Speech Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model uncertainty (measured via negative log-likelihood or bits per character) when predicting the tweets of users categorized by their preferred pronouns (masculine, feminine, and diverse) extracted from their profile descriptions.

Evaluating and comparing the predictability (via negative log-likelihood or bits per character) of tweets authored by users across five different countries (United States, Great Britain, Canada, India, and Nigeria), highlighting significantly worse model performance on Nigerian profiles likely due to dialectal differences.
